## File: facebookresearch_ram/projects/otb/otbench/cli.py

Prompts

```
['run the otbench prepare command to prepare dataset files for benchmarking', 'run the otbench generate command with a model to generate benchmark outputs', 'run the otbench eval command to evaluate model outputs against the benchmark', 'run the otbench run command to execute prepare, generate, and eval in sequence', 'run the otbench create_overthink command to generate an overthink dataset for a model']
```

